definitions.gloss: return gift for condolence money; reciprocal gift after a funeral
definitions.explanation: A gift given by the bereaved family to those who offered condolence money ({香典|こうでん}) at a funeral. Part of the Japanese custom of reciprocating gifts. Typically given after the 49-day mourning period.

examples.japanese: {香典返|こうでんがえ}しを{送|おく}る。
examples.english: To send a return gift for condolence money.

examples.japanese: {香典返|こうでんがえ}しに{何|なに}を{選|えら}ぶか{迷|まよ}った。
examples.english: I couldn't decide what to choose for the condolence return gift.

examples.japanese: {四十九日|しじゅうくにち}の{法要|ほうよう}が{終|お}わった{後|あと}に{香典返|こうでんがえ}しを{手配|てはい}した。
examples.english: I arranged the condolence return gifts after the 49th-day memorial service.

notes: Composed of {香典|こうでん} (condolence money given at funerals) + {返|かえ}し (return, reciprocation). The return gift is typically worth about half the value of the condolence money received ({半返|はんがえ}し). Common choices include tea, towels, soap, and catalog gifts. Usually sent after the {四十九日|しじゅうくにち} (49-day mourning period). This custom reflects the broader Japanese practice of {返礼|へんれい} (gift reciprocation). Related: {内祝|うちいわ}い (return gift for celebratory occasions).
